EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT c.id, sum(oi.quantity)
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE c.region = 'west'
  AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity) DESC;
